baseline: Projection of hash-verified exact upstream article order onto the existing frozen page sets.
local: Four left-to-right passes. Swap adjacent normal fixture pages only for a strict increase in forward exact-title links. Keep each page within 4096 full-corpus ranks of its destination slot baseline rank.
graph: Apply the existing SCC/greedy heuristic separately within each contiguous full-order normal region, with baseline-position tie breaks.
preserved: All non-normal page positions, the front prefix (including excluded pages), and every full-order class-region boundary.
timing: Single native size trials with full raw reconstruction; concurrent times exploratory.
limitations: Projection omits intervening pages and their context.
Not a full-pipeline or prize gain.
The existing disjoint set has already informed earlier experiments; do not present repeated selection as untouched validation.

future_confirmation.policy: If a frozen candidate improves both existing sets, prepare this predeclared third range and test without tuning on its score.

promotion: Require full raw round trips, comparable phase/binary/assets, and Linux ranking before pursuing a full-corpus candidate.
